detail:
New decision "pre-reverse-backup/ is deliberately LAST-WINS (unlike config-edit's first-wins .pre-migrate.bak): it means 'what this run is about to overwrite', which is what makes a mistaken second reverse recoverable." relates to:
- 01KWMYW8EYSG7H5MWVSS19AZYQ: "W3 1.x migrate leaves config.version at 1 and only flips storage.backend"
- 01KWN892XYHWDFBFBRVQP8E67A: "Reverse under export_records:false SKIPS ingest and exports from the database alone"
summary: Related decisions in scope: 2 existing decision(s) overlap
